--ai.help: Generate an AI-powered analysis of the search results using OpenAI API. Requires OPENAI_API_KEY env var or openai_api_key in settings.

--ai-model.help: OpenAI model to use for AI analysis (default: gpt-5.4).

--auto-disable.help: With --self-check: automatically disable sites that fail checks.

--base.help: JSON file with sites data to update.

--browse.help: Browse to all results on default bowser.

--check-claimed.help: Check if claimed username still works (aiohttp)

--cloudflare-bypass.help: Enable Cloudflare webgate bypass for sites with protection cf_js_challenge / cf_firewall / webgate. Requires a local CloudflareBypassForScraping instance (see settings.json -> cloudflare_bypass.modules[0].url).

--commitish.help: Target commit/branch for the release (default: HEAD)

--csv.help: Create a CSV report (one report per username).

--data-url.help: URL where data.json can be downloaded

--db.help: Load Maigret database from a JSON file or HTTP web resource.

--debug.help: Display extra/service/debug information and metrics, save responses in debug.log.

--diagnose.help: With --self-check: print detailed diagnosis for each failing site.

--dns-check.help: disable sites whose domains do not resolve via DNS

--dns-resolver.help: DNS resolver to use. 'async' (default) uses aiohttp's AsyncResolver (via aiodns/c-ares) — fastest under high concurrency. 'threaded' uses the OS getaddrinfo via a threadpool — slower, but respects the system DNS configuration. Switch to 'threaded' if you see 'Could not contact DNS servers' for every site (issue #2688).

--enrich.help: Fetch secondary API/JSON endpoints derived from profile URLs (via socid_extractor url_mutations) and merge extracted fields into results. Off by default; adds extra HTTP requests per claimed site.

--exclude-engine.help: do not update score with certain engine

--exclude-tags.help: Specify tags to exclude from search (blacklist).

--folderoutput.help: If using multiple usernames, the output of the results will be saved to this folder.

--force-update.help: Force check for database updates and download if available.

--graph.help: Generate a graph report (general report on all usernames).

--html.help: Create an HTML report file (general report on all usernames).

--i2p-proxy.help: Specify URL of your I2P gateway. Default is http://127.0.0.1:4444

--ignore-ids.help: Do not make search by the specified username or other ids.

--keywords.help: Specify keywords to search for in HTML content. Sites containing both username AND any keyword get special highlighting. e.g. --keywords tech python

--maigret.help: Test using Maigret's checker instead of aiohttp

--md.help: Generate a Markdown report (general report on all usernames).

--neo4j.help: Generate a Neo4j Cypher report (general report on all usernames).

--no-autoupdate.help: Disable automatic database updates on startup.

--no-extracting.help: Disable parsing pages for additional data and other usernames.

--no-recursion.help: Disable recursive search by additional data extracted from pages.

--only-engine.help: Use only this engine from detected to check

--parse.help: Parse page by URL and extract username and IDs to use for search.

--pdf.help: Generate a PDF report (general report on all usernames).

--permute.help: Permute at least 2 usernames to generate more possible usernames.

--previous-tag.help: Previous git tag (default: latest v* tag)

--print.help: Print notes only; do not edit CHANGELOG.md

--print-errors.help: Print errors messages: connection, captcha, site country ban, etc.

--print-not-found.help: Print sites where the username was not found.

--proxy.help: Make requests over a proxy. e.g. socks5://127.0.0.1:1080

--reports-sorting.help: Method of results sorting in reports (default: in order of getting the result)

--retries.help: Attempts to restart temporarily failed requests.

--samples.help: How many distinct random usernames to draw (default: 5).

--seed.help: RNG seed for reproducible username selection.

--self-check.help: Do self check for sites and database. Use --auto-disable to disable failing sites.

--site.help: Limit analysis to just the specified sites (multiple option).

--stats.help: Show database statistics (most frequent sites engines and tags).

--submit.help: URL of existing profile in new site to submit.

--top.help: Check top N sites by Alexa rank (default: 100)

--top-sites.help: Count of sites for scan ranked by Alexa Top (default: 500).

--tor-proxy.help: Specify URL of your Tor gateway. Default is socks5://127.0.0.1:9050

--txt.help: Create a TXT report (one report per username).

--use-disabled-sites.help: Use disabled sites to search (may cause many false positives).

--web.help: Launch the web interface on the specified port (default: 5000 if no PORT is provided).

--with-domains.help: Enable (experimental) feature of checking domains on usernames.

--with-rank.help: update with use of local data only

--xmind.help: Generate a legacy XML XMind mindmap with a manifest for modern readers (one report per username).
